title: Player Blocker
description: lets you block out certain players
body:
# Player Blocker
[![Fabric API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/refs/heads/v3/assets/cozy/requires/fabric-api_64h.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
[![Patreon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/refs/heads/v3/assets/cozy/donate/patreon-singular_64h.png)](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Masked404)

## Description
A minecraft mod that lets you block chat messages, whisper messages, and voice chat talking from Simple Voice Chat of specified players

### NOTE
this mod was made from pure spite about the player fiercecat8
